improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 61% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
improve.coach: 35% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one. Shows up in 70% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: Always available, always an option. 48% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling. 48% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

coach.intro: Pull up a chair, BellyTb1. 23 matches of evidence, and I've got thoughts.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
